MAPOS Assistant Project Manager/Job Captain
Mapos Architects, DPC is seeking an Assistant Project Manager for full-time employment. You will initially be joining our retail team to work with a design-forward retail client with many new and renovated store locations. Other projects in the office include private residential, medium-scale mixed-use developments, hotel/wellness, and master planning. We currently work remotely, though want applicants in New York City or the Hudson Valley for in-person meetings and site visits. In the near future, we are planning on re-opening our NYC studio and a satellite studio in Kingston, NY.
Applicants should also meet the following criteria:
We want only the best talent out there, so more than just a competitive salary and an engaging and enjoyable office culture, we offer great benefits, such as ample and flexible paid time off to fit your life, medical benefits, and a retirement savings plan. In addition to this, the founders of the company will be actively engaged in your professional development.
If interested, email a brief cover letter which includes your availability and salary expectations, resume, and work samples in PDF format (less than 5 MB) to [email protected] with the subject heading Senior PM ARCHITECT POSITION. NO PHONECALLS.
